verdict.rationale: The pack documents no first-party docs or notes feature (shared pages or note documents) for creating and organizing written content alongside boards. The closest items are adjacent rather than this capability: the Inbox captures details into cards, a Power-Up uses AI to help write content, and a community comment praises discussion on the back of a card.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work
